blocks.text: Astra Lifestyle Centre marked its formal grand opening on October 23, 2026, with a Christmas tree lighting ceremony at A.S. Fortuna Street in Banilad, Mandaue City, Cebu. This marked a milestone for Cebu Landmasters Inc. as its first fully operational lifestyle mall, bringing together dining, family leisure, and everyday conveniences in a destination designed for Cebuanos to gather, spend time with loved ones, and build new routines. Bringing dining and family experiences together Astra Lifestyle Centre brings together a mix of dining concepts, family-oriented activities, and everyday essentials.
